app.title: Show HN: After a decade of reversing, I got co-op working in DOS Wing Commander
app.author: daniel_rh
app.description: A command-line tool that emulates the co-op mode in DOS Wing Commander, allowing multiple players to connect over the network.
proposed_tests: Clone the repo and run `npm install` (or `go build`) to build the binary
Run `wcmulti start` and verify it listens on the expected port
Connect two instances and ensure they synchronize game state correctly
Measure start-up time and compare against baseline single-player execution
